title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in Farke Lake
description_en: 2+1+2 bathroom apartment for sale in a new complex in Farka Lake. The apartment has a total area of ​​119.4 m2 and a net area of ​​100.5. One of the other strengths of this apartment is its orientation and view from Lake Farka. It is organized in a cooking area and living and cooking together, two bedrooms, two bathrooms, balcony. The apartment also has a parking space with an extra price of 20,000 euros. Order contracts are available.
